title: BNCI 2015-012 PASS2D P300 dataset
description: EEG recordings from 10 mostly BCI-naive participants using PASS2D, a nine-class auditory ERP speller. Users attended to two-dimensional auditory stimuli varying in pitch and direction, presented via headphones, to drive a predictive (T9-style) text entry system. Data comprise calibration and online spelling runs recorded with 63 EEG channels, plus one EOG channel. The dataset supports P300/N200 classification and auditory BCI research.
methods_description: Single 3-4 hour session per participant with a calibration phase (3 runs of 9 trials, each with pseudo-random sequences of 9 auditory stimuli) and an online spelling phase (2 runs spelling German sentences). EEG was recorded at 250 Hz with 63 wet Ag/AgCl electrodes (Brain Products, nose reference), then filtered and downsampled to 100 Hz. Classification used shrinkage-regularized Fisher discriminant analysis on amplitudes from discriminative N200 and P300 intervals.
